connector.name: Ovh Api MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the OVH API. Explore and call any OVH endpoint via sandboxed JS.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image ovh-api-mcp:0.3.0. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidlandais account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
